**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Out of 380 commits, one real feature and ten fixes matter to users. The rest was dependency bumps, refactors, and internal test churn.

One change is breaking: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`, worth flagging to anyone checking status codes.

Next: check the entry reads right, then tag the release.
